source_review.source: Nicolaescu, Notes on the Atiyah-Singer Index Theorem, revision 2013-11-15
source_review.examined: Complete Chapter 4 pp.139-166 and complete Proposition 2.2.26 proof pp.87-88, text extraction; introduction and contents for scope. Not the whole book.
source_review.finding: Full downloaded text contains deferred-but-absent Proposition 4.3.4 proof, cited Lemma 4.3.6, stated Mehler formula, blank final 4.3.4. These are construction obligations, not proved suppliers.
source_review.local_completion: construction.md duties 6-9 give graph-norm Duhamel remainder, radial-gauge curvature derivation, Gaussian Riccati verification and supertrace normalization.

source_review.examined: Full Theorem III.6.5 and proof, printed pp.134-135, text extraction; contents. Not the whole book.
source_review.finding: Core embedding compatibility explicitly referred elsewhere. Rejected as a complete index proof supplier.

source_review.source: Melrose, Analysis Loops and Spin, Loops2024 author-hosted PDF
source_review.examined: Complete section 1.15, printed pp.31-33, text extraction. Not the whole notes.
source_review.finding: Cech lift construction with explicit remaining w2 identification and torsor obligations; construction duty 1 fills these.

source_review.source: Wernli, Lecture Notes on Spin Geometry 2019
source_review.examined: Spin/twisted-spin index formulas; complete 4.2 definitions/Theorem 4.2.4, pp.89-90; end of heat proof including rescaling-convergence footnote p.103. Not the whole notes.
source_review.finding: Defines intended general Clifford-module formula and exact twisted-spin specialization; rescaling convergence is not proved there. Local coefficient/Duhamel route avoids that unproved inference.
